title: MatchResult
description: Per-element matcher verdict, produced by the MCP tool's two-factor gate (R5) and consumed by the Unity assembler.

status.description: fallback_eligible: a composite (Combine) group scored below the missing floor against the existing catalog, but a hi-res capture of the group was taken in the Figma plugin at Combine-confirm time - offered for import as a new catalog entry instead of a plain miss.

matched_asset_id.description: References catalog-entry.json's id; null when status is missing or fallback_eligible.

margin.description: Score margin over the runner-up candidate (R5).

resize.description: Present when matched_asset_id's native size differs from the element's rect (R14).

safe.description: true for Sliced/Tiled auto-resize; false when a Simple-type asset would distort beyond tolerance.
